messages:
maria: kicking off AZ9 account + vpc bootstrap. primary goals: get GPU quota requested, VNet scafolded, NAT + route tables validated. I put the checklist in the drive link: https://drive.redwood.internal/az9-bootstrap
raj: saw the doc, ty. are we doing single vnet per project or shared transit for this region?
oliver: for AZ9 we agreed to trial the shared-transit pattern (hub VNet w/ spoke per cluster) to reduce peering overhead. still need to confirm egress path for docker pulls.
maria: yep hub + spokes. hub will host NAT, peering, and the private endpoint for our image registry. spoke will be small subnets per GPU cluster.
sophie: quota request submitted to cloud provider for 12 A100s and 8 T4s, request id: Q-984312. ETA 48-72h per support. cc @raj for billing tag. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
raj: added billing tag = infra-az9-gpu to the request. cost estimate looked ~ $18k/mo if fully up. sharing with finance.
kai: quick check — did we reserve private IP space for future pods? last time we ran into pod IP exhaustion when subnets were too tight. proposal: /20 for hub, /19 aggregate for spokes, split into /24s.
oliver: that matches our subnet sizing table. hub /20, each gpu-spoke /22 initial, can expand later. update the terraform templates to use variable `spoke_prefixes_count`.
maria: provisioning plan: 1) create account and permissions 2) create hub VNet + NAT gateway 3) create spokes + route tables 4) deploy small canary gpu cluster (1 A100) 5) run smoke loads & perf traces.
provision-bot: terraform apply started by maria on 1919002340: plan shows 6 resources to create.
provision-bot: terraform apply complete on 1919002460: hub-vnet, nat-gw, rg-hub created.
sophie: hub resources good. firewall rules allow egress to registry + metrics endpoints? I added service tags for storage and container registry.
kai: added a route table to send 0.0.0.0/0 via NAT, and explicit route for monitoring endpoints to the metrics subnet. test ping from jumpbox?
maria: jumpbox spin-up finished. ssh into jumpbox, `curl -sS https://registry.redwood.internal/healthz` returns 200.
raj: can we validate KV cache access from canary cluster namespace? that's been flaky across regions.
oliver: deploying canary cluster now with k8s 1.26 and gpu nodepool (1 x A100). helm deploy `redwood-canary` with env `REGION=az9`. logs show kubelet ok but GPU drivers not present.
sophie: am assuming driver install step missing in the machine image. did we upload the GPU-enabled image to the region?
maria: good catch — image propagation failed. triggering image sync job. provision-bot: image-sync job queued (job-553).
provision-bot: image-sync job completed on 1919002980: image `rwd-gpu-ubuntu-2026-02` available in AZ9.
oliver: redeploying node pool with new image. node comes up, nvidia-smi shows 1 GPU. :tada:
kai: running perf smoke: short token-gen workload, p95 latency target < 150ms. starting load at 20rps.
maria: load run 1 — p95 = 132ms, CPU ~48%, GPU util ~35%. memory within expected. logging snapshot in ops dashboard.
raj: good. what's next for handoff to platform team? any manual steps?
maria: handoff checklist: 1) confirm quotas granted 2) doc updated with subnet ranges and peering ids 3) cost tagging verified 4) create runbook entry for failover to eu3 5) schedule knowledge transfer session. I've created PR #452 to update docs.
sophie: PR reviewed, added note about driver image TTL and auto-sync policy.
provision-bot: runbook artifact created: /runbooks/az9-onboard-2026-02.md
maria: planning a 30m HT session tomorrow 10:30 PT. invite sent. any blockers?
raj: only pending is final quota approval, but support replied to expedite if we ping. I'll escalate if not done in 24h.
oliver: all infra terraform and k8s manifests in the `infra/az9` repo branch `az9-bootstrap`. please don't force-merge until HT.
maria: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for the initial bootstrap. will update thread when Dedicated capacity request is approved. :white_check_mark:
